verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs describe handing off tasks to its built-in agent: Plan Mode for scoped changes, subagents that the agent delegates to in editor, CLI and cloud, and cloud agents that build, test and demo work end to end with PR artifacts. Run Modes govern how autonomously the agent executes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-product task delegation; all evidence is first-party vendor docs.
